title: Doubles
examples: Teacher, what does double three mean?
Can you show me double seven?
Is double five the same as five plus five?

explain.say: Today you will learn about doubles. Double means two of the same number. Double two is two and two. That makes four.
Double five is five and five. That makes ten.
Double three is three and three. That makes six.
Double four is four and four. That makes eight.
Doubles help you count pairs. Two pairs of socks are double two. That is four socks.
A double has two groups. Count both groups. Double five is ten.

faq.a: It means you are counting a number two times. You are finding the total of two equal groups.
asks: What is double of a number?

faq.q: Is double five the same as five plus five?
faq.a: Yes, it is exactly the same. Double five means five plus five, which equals ten.
asks: How do I write double five?

faq.q: Can I use doubles for bigger numbers?
faq.a: Yes, you can use it for any number. For example, double ten is ten plus ten, which is twenty.
asks: Does this work for big numbers?

faq.a: Yes, double two always means two plus two, which is four. It is a fixed fact.
asks: What is the answer for double two?

faq.q: Do I have to draw pictures for doubles?
faq.a: It helps to draw pictures to see the two groups. You can draw two groups of the same number of objects.
asks: How can I see two groups?

facts: Doubles means adding a number to itself.
For a double, the two groups are the same size.

quiz.say: Look at the dots. What is double two?
quiz.why: Two and two more make four.

wrong.0: Two is one group, so count the second group too.
wrong.2: Six is double three, and here you double two.

quiz.why: Five and five more make ten.

wrong.1: Five is one group, so add the second five too.
wrong.2: Fifteen is three fives, and a double has only two.

quiz.say: Count both groups of blocks. How many altogether?
quiz.why: Four and four more make eight.

wrong.0: Four is one group, so count the other group too.
wrong.1: Twelve is three groups of four, and here there are two.
